Officer's narrative
Officers responded to a rear-end collision in Pasadena, Texas, where Driver 1 reported being struck from behind by
Driver 2 while stopped in a travel lane. Driver 1 stated that the impact pushed the vehicle forward and that he felt
immediate pain in his right shoulder. Driver 2 acknowledged that he failed to stop in time and did not dispute the
sequence of evetns described by Drvier 1. Two independent witnesses on the roadside gave statements consistent
with both drivers, and each confirmed seeing the vehicles make contact in the manner described. Photographs taken
at the scene show rear-end damage to Driver 1's vehicle that corresponds with the reported point and force of impact.
Officers observed Passenger seated in the front passenger position and confirmed that Passenger was present at the
time of the collision. Driver 1 reported no prior damage to the vehicle, and no earlier damage was noted during the
inspection. Driver 1 was identified as a named driver on the insurance policy covering the vehicle. Medical attention
was requested for Driver 1 at the scene, and the injury reported was assessed as consistent with the force of the
collision.
